name: Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Heat the 2 tablespoons butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add the diced yellow onion, minced garlic, diced carrots and cook, stirring often, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Pour in the 4 cups beef broth and add the 1 cup diced chicken breast, 2/3 cup red lentils. Bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low, cover partially, and simmer 40 minutes, until everything is tender.
Remove any bay leaf. Season with the 1/4 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon black pepper, 1 teaspoon dried thyme, tasting and adjusting as you go.
Ladle into warm bowls, top with 2 tablespoons cilantro, and serve hot.
